canonical_surface_facts.wire_literal_rule: EF4-I22 prohibits duplicated CLI, MCP, HTTP, persistence, and UI wire literals

contradictions_or_gaps.description: The thirteen names are canonical, but no authority maps each name to an exact request schema, response schema, handler operation, or read-model envelope.
Planning tools are placed in T01 beside side-effect-free reads, but the contract does not say whether they are pure computation or durable plan-artifact creation with receipts.
No MCP protocol/version, descriptor, schema-reference resolution base, content framing, or error mapping is frozen.
Handler-service, authorization, workspace scoping, audit telemetry, receipt, and cross-surface conformance ownership are not assigned.
T01 may write only the plugin-host read adapter path, so it cannot lawfully invent or repair the missing central/generated contract, handler, or conformance-test authorities.

classification.not_fail_reason: No authorized implementation was attempted and therefore no implementation defect is established.
classification.not_blocked_reason: The gap does not result from a missing external service, credential, licensed source, toolchain, or host capability.
prohibited_shortcuts: embed ad hoc request or response JSON Schema in the T01 adapter
guess one candidate domain schema for ambiguous tools
treat OpenAPI transport envelopes as MCP authority without a mapping contract
silently make planning tools persistent or silently make them ephemeral
invent authorization scopes, workspace rules, or errors
claim read side-effect freedom while emitting undefined audit or receipt effects
create handler services outside T01 write scope

required_product_owner_decisions: exact per-tool input, output, envelope, handler, side-effect, and capability matrix
MCP version, descriptor, schema-reference, framing, and error contract
planning purity versus durable artifact and receipt semantics
authorization, workspace, confidentiality, and concealment rules
read audit telemetry and receipt allowance under side-effect freedom
provider-neutral handler-service and cross-surface parity owner
minimum exact resolving write scopes and acceptance fixtures
